page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8i.xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture, driven by an Intel Xeon 8475B processor operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. This 1:2 processor-to-memory ratio aligns with compute-intensive hardware profiles.

This instance does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 4 Gbps. There are no complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this configuration.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation ensures predictable performance without the resource contention typical of shared-core or burstable instances. The lack of local storage and integrated graphics limits its utility for data-heavy storage workloads or GPU-accelerated tasks, but optimizes the instance for pure compute workloads. Suitable use cases include web serving, batch processing, and application servers that require dedicated CPU cycles but have modest memory footprints.
